# FLX-1006: non-finite Decimal in a document being canonicalised

**Family:** canonicalisation (the 1000 band)

A NaN, sNaN or Infinity Decimal has no JSON spelling and no ordering, so it can carry no digest. Refuse it where it is produced rather than hashing a placeholder.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-1006
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
